title: Schedules that run for you
summary: Approve schedules your bots run on their own, and sign in to Hermes from the terminal.

highlights.title: Scheduled routines
highlights.body: Bots can run routines on a schedule you approve. A task center lists them, and each scheduled run appears on its chat message, on desktop and mobile.

highlights.title: Hermes, upgraded
highlights.body: Hermes moves to a newer version, and you can sign in to ChatGPT or Claude for it from the terminal.

items.text: Apps can open chat recipes in the desktop app.
Older Codex conversations resume with the right account.
Finished Codex runs show their results even after a long wait.
The browser desktop recovers when it's running an outdated version.
Chats inherited from a shared project can ask the AI again.
